meta.tagline: Trusted digital services for social media, gaming, subscriptions and design
meta.description: Hassouni Digital Services — digital services in Iraq: social media, game top-ups, digital subscriptions and professional design, priced in Iraqi Dinar.

home.statSpeed: Game top-ups and cards within 10–20 minutes of payment confirmation
home.heroTitle: All your digital services in one place
home.heroSubtitle: Followers and likes, PUBG and Ludo top-ups, ChatGPT and Telegram Premium subscriptions, gift cards, design and montage — pay with Zain Cash, AsiaCell or Qi Card (Super Qi), or from your wallet, and chat with us right on the site.

how.title: Pick a service
how.body: Browse the categories and choose the package or quantity you need.

how.title: Add the details
how.body: Provide only what is required, such as a player ID or profile link. We never ask for passwords.

how.title: Pay and send proof
how.body: Follow the payment method instructions and send the transaction number or receipt for review.

how.title: Follow your order
how.body: We verify the payment manually, then start working. Track the status on your order page.

home.supportBody: Our team is available to answer your questions on WhatsApp, Telegram and Instagram.

wallet.walletIdHint: This is your ID. If you contact us to top up, send it to us so we add the balance to your account.

topupSteps: Choose the amount and payment method
Transfer the exact amount to the number shown (or scan the QR code)
Send the transaction number or a receipt photo
We review it and add the balance within 10–20 minutes

how: Top up your balance once with any available payment method.
Pay for orders from your balance in one tap — no transfer or receipt each time.
If an order paid from the wallet is refunded, the money returns to your wallet automatically.

walletPage.intro: Customers send top-up requests after transferring to you. Make sure the money actually arrived before approving. Manual credit/debit is admin-only and recorded in the audit log.
walletPage.findTitle: Credit or debit a wallet manually
walletPage.notFound: No single customer matches (none, or more than one). Try the username.

reviewsPage.intro: All reviews come from customers whose orders were completed and are published immediately. Hide only abusive content, personal data or ads — not honest negative reviews; a polite reply builds more trust.

supportPage.browserEnable: Enable browser notifications (and sound) on this device

supportPage.browserBlocked: The browser blocks notifications. Allow them in the site settings of your browser.
supportPage.telegram: Telegram alerts (reach your phone even when the site is closed)
supportPage.telegramSteps:
1) In Telegram open @BotFather, send /newbot, create a bot and copy its token.
2) In Netlify: Environment variables → add TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN with the token, then redeploy.
3) Open your bot in Telegram and press Start.
4) Come back here and press “Link Telegram”.
supportPage.telegramDone: Linked with {name}. A test message was sent to Telegram.
